text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China's criminal law adds provisions for securities-related crimes for the first time.
- Dai Xianglong, governor of the People's Bank of China, says the central bank aims to reduce bad debts by two percent each year in the next few years.
- Remote computerised trading adopted by the Shanghai stock exchange late last year has benefited retail investors.
- BUSINESS NEWS - The Bank of China has signed agreement with the Shanghai city government to supply $1.5 billion in the next three years for the development of the Pudong New Area.
- Shanghai had a total of 3,166 labour disputes in 1996, an increase of 24 percent against 1995.
- China has built its largest shipyard with a capacity of 300,000 tonnes in northern city of Dalian.
